restore_chip.name: Restore Chip
restore_chip.desc: Revives a fainted Bytekin at half HP.

stability_clamp.name: Stability Clamp
stability_clamp.desc: Battle: lowers a wild Bytekin's Stability by 30.

contain_module.name: Contain Module
contain_module.desc: Boosts a CONTAIN attempt x1.5. Select under CONTAIN.

signal_beacon.name: Signal Beacon
signal_beacon.desc: Doubles wild encounter rate for 80 steps.

signal_crystal.name: Signal Crystal
signal_crystal.desc: A crystal humming with spare bandwidth. Evolves certain SIGNAL Bytekin.

cache_fragment.name: Cache Fragment
cache_fragment.desc: A shard of duplicated data. Sells well.

pixel_dust.name: Pixel Dust
pixel_dust.desc: Fine glitter left by corrupted Bytekin.

debugger.name: Debugger
debugger.desc: Professor Vale's handheld. Scans, indexes and CONTAINS Bytekin.

relay_note.name: Relay Note
relay_note.desc: A scrap from the Old Signal Relay: TRIANGLE, CIRCLE, SQUARE. 'When the signal flows, the tower wakes.'

relay_pass.name: Relay Keycard
relay_pass.desc: Opens the Old Signal Relay maintenance door.

root_key_01.name: Root Key 01
root_key_01.desc: Proof that Node 1 (Briarfield) is restored. Grants PULSE.

pulse_module.name: PULSE Module
pulse_module.desc: Field ability: wakes dormant Signal switches.
